items.prompt: Repaint the original Shadow Shot game card, landscape 4:3. Input 1 is original edit target, preserve its composition: silver-haired male mage Changwuyu waist-up at center-left, torso turned sideways toward right while looking back toward viewer, one black-gloved arm foreshortened extending toward viewer on left, open casting palm. Two long thin dark-purple shadow arrows cross from lower-left edges to upper-right, points converge near upper-right. Preserve arrow directions, character placement, camera and gesture. Input 2 is character identity only: silver long hair in low bun and long side locks, pointed ears, golden eyes behind thin round glasses, black bent-point broad-brim witch hat with purple underside, black high-neck robe, gold trim, purple cloak lining, left chest white feather and blue sapphire brooch, no staff. Keep quiet pale lavender solid-color background; remove small diagram-like target icon on right. Inputs 3-5 are drawing-style references only. Rough hand-painted anime color study. Large connected opaque masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade edges and selective unfinished areas. Group hair into substantial locks and cloth into principal fold planes. Clear anime eyes and readable hands, economical face marks; other regions coarse and quiet. Matte muted colors with concentrated violet and gold accents. No fine strands, dense wrinkles, facet mosaics, glossy rendering or all-over texture filters. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
